start.description: BEGIN, where legs start: [x, y] = [easting, northing]

items.description: one tangent, from one PI to the next: a direction (exactly one of bearing, azimuth, deflection, angle_right) and the distance to the next PI; radius is the curve at the PI where this leg starts (a leg after the first). Or as text: "S 80°00'00\" E 800", "40 L 700 R=500"

bearing.description: quadrant bearing: N 45°30'15" E, S45-30-15W, N45E

deflection.description: the angle the alignment turns at the PI where this leg starts: '40 L', '25°00'00" RT', or a number with right positive; or its size with turn

distance.description: feet from this leg's PI to the next PI

radius.description: the curve at the PI where this leg starts (0 or omitted: none, which needs angle_points)

legs.description: the layout as bearings and distances, PI to PI from start -- as a report describes it: 'S 80° E 800 ft to PI-2, where it deflects 40° left on a 500 ft curve; then 700 ft...' is [{bearing: 'S 80 E', distance: 800}, {deflection: '40 L', radius: 500, distance: 700}, ...]

angle_points.description: allow interior PIs of radius 0: angle points, where the tangents meet with no curve -- a layout whose curves come later (default false: a missing radius is refused)
